modules.title: 为什么界面里看得到旧消息，AI 仍可能不知道“第二条”
旧消息怎样重新进入下一次请求

items.title: 产品先保存旧消息
items.text: 聊天产品可以把原来的三个标题和后续回复保存在自己的记录里，供界面展示或之后查找。

items.title: 应用选择相关部分
items.text: 收到“把第二条改短”后，应用从记录中取回那三个标题，并把它们和新消息一起发送。

items.title: 模型只看实际收到的内容
items.text: 如果这次请求只有一句“把第二条改短”，模型就看不到界面里的旧标题，也无法可靠判断指代。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 对话历史说的是产品保存了哪些旧消息；无状态请求说的是每次调用仍要重新提供本轮需要的内容。保存不等于发送。

lessonPractice.title: 用户在很长对话后说“把第二条改短”，界面能看到所有旧消息，但模型答错了对象。怎样改进？

options.label: 在本次请求中带回相关列表和指代，并控制无关历史的长度
options.feedback: 模型需要当前所指内容才能解析“第二条”，界面可见不代表请求实际包含它。

options.label: 每次永久发送完整历史，不考虑窗口、费用或无关信息
options.feedback: 全量历史会持续占用空间和成本，还可能让旧目标干扰当前任务。

options.label: 保持界面显示旧消息即可，不必检查请求里有没有发送
options.feedback: 产品保存和展示消息是一层，组装模型输入是另一层，二者不能互相替代。

en.title: After a long chat, a user says Shorten the second one. All old messages are visible, but the model edits the wrong item. How should this improve?

options.label: Include the relevant list and reference in this request while limiting unrelated history
options.feedback: The model needs the referenced content to resolve second; visible history does not prove it was sent.

options.label: Always send the complete history without considering window, cost, or relevance
options.feedback: Full history continuously consumes space and cost and may let outdated goals interfere with the task.

options.label: Keep old messages visible in the UI and do not inspect whether the request includes them
options.feedback: Saving and displaying messages is separate from assembling model input, so one cannot replace the other.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查这次发给模型的内容里有没有原来的三个标题。保留与“第二条”有关的消息，较早且无关的对话不用带；不要因为聊天界面还显示旧消息，就假定模型已经收到了。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Before editing the second item, confirm the referenced list is in the current context and restate the target. Keep only relevant history and summarize older material; never assume visible UI messages were sent.

learning.assumes: You have used a chat product that supports follow-up questions.
learning.outcome: You can explain that continuous chat depends on the product bringing relevant earlier messages into the next request.

modules.title: Why can the AI miss “the second one” when old messages are still visible?
How old messages enter a new request

items.title: The product saves old messages
items.text: The chat product can keep the three titles and later replies in its own records.

items.title: The application selects relevant parts
items.text: For this request, it retrieves the three titles and sends them with the new message.

items.title: The model sees only what was sent
items.text: If the request contains only “make the second one shorter,” visible UI history cannot resolve the reference.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Conversation history is what the product has saved. A stateless request still needs the relevant material supplied again. Saved does not mean sent.
